To avoid overwhelming you with review comments due to an influx of new commits, CodeRabbit has automatically paused this review. You can configure this behavior by changing the `reviews.auto_review.auto_pause_after_reviewed_commits` setting. > > Use the following commands to manage reviews: > - `@coderabbitai resume` to resume automatic reviews. > - `@coderabbitai review` to trigger a single review. > > Use the checkboxes below for quick actions: > - [ ] ▶️ Resume reviews > - [ ] 🔍 Trigger review
📝 Walkthrough ## Walkthrough This PR adds portable UUID relationship validation, normalization, graph inspection, and update admission, with cross-platform tests. It also records planning and verification evidence and adds a hosted review workflow. Writer integration, reader-projection repair, parity, and release qualification remain incomplete. ### Changes **UUID Relationship Contract and Review Preparation** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |:---|:---| |**Portable relationship contract and tests**
`src/rheos/backend/{law,shape,domain}/relationships.cljc`, `test/rheos/backend/*/relationships_test.cljc`, `test/rheos/relationship_contract_runner.cljc`|The contract validates relationship shapes, normalizes inputs, inspects complete snapshots, and admits relationship updates only when graph checks pass. Tests cover malformed references, cycles, hierarchy rules, batch behavior, no-ops, ordering, and large hierarchies.| |**Contract checkpoint and execution evidence**
`docs/agile/tasks/rheos-issue-3-relationship-contract.md`, `docs/verification/portable-relationship-contract.md`, `.ημ/verification/rheos-relationships-contract-20261008/*`, `.ημ/review-evidence/rheos4-portable-contract-green-20261008.json`|The records document contract scope and test outcomes across JVM and ClojureScript. They also report that the public CLI projection omits relationship fields, and do not claim writer integration or parity.| |**Relationship planning and evidence**
`docs/notes/uuid-relationship-authoring-plan.md`, `docs/agile/epics/*`, `docs/agile/tasks/rheos-issue-3-relationship-{writer,parity}.md`, `.ημ/receipts.edn`, `.ημ/session-mycology/ledger.md`, `.ημ/verification/rheos-issue3-planning-20261006/*`, `.ημ/verification/rheos4-parity-scope-20261006/*`|Planning documents specify proposed authoring, writer, and parity work. Captures and append-only records document readbacks, preservation checks, corrected capture counts, and scope boundaries.| |**Hosted review route preparation**
`.github/workflows/eta-mu-review.yml`, `.gitignore`, `docs/verification/canonical-review-route.md`, `.ημ/review-evidence/*`|The workflow invokes a pinned review workflow and defines dependency, lint, test, and build gate conditions. The records document source-bootstrap and disk-reserve checks; hosted execution and current-head approval are not claimed.| **Priority:** ➖ Normal **Estimated code review effort:** 4 (Complex) | ~45 minutes **Change:** Feature

performed_via_github_app.description:
# Transforming Code Reviews with AI

## Features

**Automated Reviews**: Continuous reviews of the pull requests including incremental commits. 

**Summarization**: Generates high-level summary and a technical walkthrough of the PR changes. 

**Line-by-line review**: Provides line-by-line suggestions committable with one click.

**Codebase verification**:  Verifies the impact on the overall codebase and identifies missing changes.

**Insights into your code**:  Ask any questions on your codebase within the pull request 

**Chat about your code** : Chat with the bot around your code. The more you chat, the smarter it gets.

**Issue Validation**:  Validates the PR against the linked issues and identifies other related issues
